func main() {
	x, y := 1, 2
	x++
	y--
	x += y *
		2
	ch := make(chan int, 1)
	ch <- x; <-ch
	var done <-chan struct{}
	if v := f(); v > 0 {
		return
	} else if v < 0 {
		panic("negative")
	} else {
	}
	// Composite literals in headers must be parenthesized when the type is a name.
	if p == (Point{1, 2}) {
	}
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		continue
	}
	for _, v := range []int{1, 2} {
		_ = v
	}
	for range 3 {
	}
	for x < y {
	}
outer:
	for {
		select {
		case v, ok := <-ch:
			_, _ = v, ok
			break outer
		case ch <- 1:
		case <-done:
			goto end
		default:
		}
	}
	switch s := g(); s {
	case 1, 2:
		fallthrough
	default:
	}
	switch t := v.(type) {
	case nil, *int, []string, map[string]any, func() error:
	case interface{ M() }:
		_ = t
	}
	go func() {}()
	defer println(x /* inline */, y)
	m := map[string][]int{"a": {1}, "b": nil}
	s := m["a"][1:]
	z := -x * ^y &^ *p / <-ch
end:
